newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metrobank dips on loan default rumour.
newsitem.headline: Metrobank dips on loan default rumour.

text.p: Metropolitan Bank & Trust Co fell 20 pesos or 3.47 percent to 555 pesos on Wednesday on rumours that a sugar milling firm, which it has a big loan exposure, is facing financial troubles, brokers said.
"There is the rumour that San Carlos Milling is experiencing problems with its imported sugar inventories, and that it will affect its loan payment to Metrobank," said one broker.
Another trader said Metrobank had a 1.1 billion peso loan to San Carlos. However, the loan was collateralised with 1.8 billion pesos worth of assets.
Metrobank and San Carlos officials were not immediately available for comment.
Metrobank was the most heavily traded issue in late session while San Carlos was untraded.
